gloss: to protect; to preserve; to shelter

definitions.gloss: to protect; to preserve; to safeguard
definitions.explanation: To keep something or someone safe from harm, danger, or deterioration through active measures.

definitions.gloss: to take into custody; to shelter; to give refuge
definitions.explanation: To take a person or animal into protective care, especially by authorities.

notes:
A very common word that spans legal, environmental, animal welfare, and computing contexts. Sense 2 (taking into custody/shelter) is particularly common in news about lost children, stray animals, and disaster victims.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{保護|ほご}→環境保護：15308_kankyouhogo⟧: environmental protection
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}{保護|ほご}→自然保護：09599_shizenhogo⟧: nature conservation
- ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: consumer protection
- ⟦{保護|ほご}{者|しゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧: guardian, parent/caregiver
- ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧/⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: rescued cat/dog
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: welfare, public assistance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect, to defend — more everyday; implies active defense against threats
- ⟦{保全|ほぜん}→保全：11560_hozen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preserve, to conserve — more technical; focuses on maintaining current state
- ⟦{擁護|ようご}→擁護：14953_yougo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to defend, to advocate for — implies championing a cause or defending rights
